redundant_but_required.finding: There is heavy textual duplication -- energy_terms.py:136-143 is byte-identical to core/energy.py:199-206; vqe.py against core/quantum.py; peptide_db._scan against core/data._scan; s8/project.RamaPenalty against core/project.

frozen_do_not_touch.mechanism: fragment_db.py:80 and core/data.py:742 do sorted(glob(...)) then rng.shuffle(paths). Adding, removing or renaming ONE file re-permutes the whole corpus -> different fragments kept -> different retrieval library -> different pool -> a different final RMSD on every target.

_scan membership -> load() -> clusters() -> dev_set(24), whose reps list is indexed by rng.permutation(len(reps)). len(reps) changing by ONE re-draws all 24 dev targets, which changes the exclusion set, which changes the entire tuning126 manifest.

WRITE-ON-FIRST-USE caches. A missing file is not an error, it is a silent re-derivation. Correcting the identity clustering once moved 13 benchmark targets and invalidated every model on disk. This is the most dangerous operation in the repository and it looks like a trivial data tidy-up.

frozen_do_not_touch.what: s9/synth_cache, s9/final_cache, s8/generate_univ, s8/consensus2_cache, s7/*_cache, bench_results/cache
frozen_do_not_touch.mechanism: Tests SKIP silently when these are absent. Removing them looks green and deletes coverage.

Not a script folder. core/project.py WRITES its evidence there (_outpath) and READS project_inputs.json and project_equiv.json back at runtime; tests/test_project.py globs it; tests/test_integration.py imports three of its scripts as modules.

frozen_do_not_touch.what: the 24 root modules and the s5/s7/s8/s9 packages
frozen_do_not_touch.mechanism: Seven root modules set BASE = dirname(abspath(__file__)) and assume it IS the repository root, resolving pdbs/, prots/, results/ and the pinned caches from it. All eleven sprint modules do sys.path.insert(dirname(dirname(__file__))) with a hardcoded hop count, and core/bench.py rebuilds that preamble in a SUBPROCESS where a parent shim would not reach.
